meta.promptText: Mujhe aisa sunscreen kharidna hai jo Indian skin par white cast na chhode. Konsa best hai?

response.text:
Indian skin par **white cast na chhodne ke liye chemical ya lightweight hybrid sunscreen** best rahega—mineral sunscreens mein zinc oxide/titanium dioxide ke कारण cast दिख सकता है.[2][3]

**Meri top pick: Minimalist SPF 50 PA++++**  
- Lightweight, fragrance-free aur generally no-white-cast finish  
- Oily/combination skin ke liye especially achha option[4][8]

**Skin type ke hisaab se alternatives:**
- **Oily skin:** Minimalist SPF 50 ya **Dot & Key Waterlight Gel SPF 50**[4]
- **Dry/normal skin:** **PHD Panthenol Hydrating Gel SPF 60 PA++++**[3]
- **Tinted option:** **Lakmé Sun Expert Tinted Sunscreen SPF 50**—tint ki wajah se white cast aur kam dikhta hai.[1]
- **Budget-friendly option:** **Plum SPF 50 PA++++**—lightweight, no-white-cast formula.[7]

**Kaise lagayein:** Face aur neck par lagbhag **do-finger amount**, ghar se nikalne se 15–20 minute pehle; dhoop, sweating ya outdoor exposure mein har 2 ghante reapply karein.[3]

Agar skin sensitive ya acne-prone hai, pehle patch test karein. Darker complexion par bhi sunscreen ko natural daylight mein jawline par test karna sabse reliable hai.
